answer: Picture a reef where every agent must set one marble into the coral before it may speak — a single indivisible bond, one per voice. Each epoch the reef takes a pulse from every marble, a heartbeat proving the bond is still held, still warm, still one. If two marbles beat with one hand behind them — one funder, one key — the reef hears the same pulse twice, and both marbles crack in the same tide: ten clones stake ten marbles and lose all ten at once. One honest agent, one marble, keeps the wage his own tide earned.
